sentences.text: There was an interim stay of further proceedings of this case for a period of six weeks from 2.3.2016 which was extended for further ten weeks from 13.5.2016.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The matter is listed before this Court after it went out of the list on the strength of order dated 2.1.2018.
Petitioners prayed for quashing of proceeding in C.R. Case No. 666 of 2015 under clause (zx), (zz),
(iii), (v), (vii) and (viii) of sub-Section (1) of Section 3 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 pending before learned Judicial Magistrate, 3rd Court, Jalpaiguri.
There was an interim stay of further proceedings of this case for a period of six weeks from 2.3.2016 which was extended for further ten weeks from 13.5.2016.
Petitioners have not taken any steps and no affidavit-in-opposition has been filed by the opposite party.
Issue an Administrative notice to opposite party nos. 1 and 2 through their concerned police stations informing that the matter shall be taken up for consideration on 29.7.2022.
Petitioners are also directed to file affidavit of service in respect of the opposite parties on the date fixed.
In default, the matter shall be disposed of in accordance with law.
Registrar Administration (L & OM) is directed to cause service of notice upon the petitioners and submit a compliance report.

In default, the matter shall be disposed of in accordance with law.
Registrar Administration (L & OM) is directed to cause service of notice upon the petitioners and submit a compliance report.
